title: Receiving Stolen Property
key_points: Knowingly receiving, keeping or disposing of movable property of another, knowing it is stolen or believing it is probably stolen.
Knowledge is presumed in certain situations, such as possessing a vehicle with an altered VIN or being a dealer who buys at a price far below value.
elements: The suspect knowingly received, retained or disposed of movable property of another
Knowing the property was stolen, or believing it was probably stolen
Determine the value (sets the grade); check the statutory presumptions of knowledge
